finalText: Migration's done. 12 files had stragglers on `db.query` — `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `returnService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `refund.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `shipment.js`, and `cohort.js` — all now call `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Left `cache.query` and the vendored `legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since those aren't part of this migration. The repo's own verify script confirms a clean pass.
